title: The Layers panel knows a group is a row or a column
goal: Turning a group into a row or a column is only on the Layer menu in the menu bar, and in the Layers list a stack looks exactly like a plain group. The auto-layout mock puts it first in the Layers panel menu and writes row or column, and how each child is sized, on the rows' quiet second line, so you can see the layout without picking each thing.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-autolayout.html #layerMenu ('Wrap in auto-layout' first) and row meta lmeta ~223, ~472-476. Code: panel menu rows Sources/PhotonzCore/LayersPanelHeader.swift ~43-46; right-click Sources/Photonz/LayerCommandMenu.swift ~184-188, 224 (Group, Ungroup, Make Component, no stack); menu bar only at Sources/Photonz/EditorCommands.swift ~1958. Row second line Sources/Photonz/LayersRow.swift ~75-100, 283-297. Keep the second line short (UX-PATTERNS section 4). Mind the open card on Layers order in a column (a-column-lists-its-rows-in-the-order-the-user-ch): do not change row order here.
acceptance: At Next defaults the Layers panel menu and a layer's right-click menu both carry the stack command, matching the menu bar's wording
A stacked group's row says row or column on its second line, and each child row says hug, fill or fixed, as ui-autolayout.html draws it
Rows of plain groups and layers read exactly as today
A walk stacks two shapes from the Layers panel menu and reads the row text, green at Next defaults
Audit written under queue/audits/ with the panel beside the mock; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial review before building: (1) the mock's panel menu row is 'Wrap in auto-layout ⇧A'; the app's command is Layer > Stack Selection on Control Command G, and the acceptance asks the panel and right-click rows to match the menu bar, so both say Stack Selection with ⌃⌘G (⇧A is a Figma key and would collide with nothing-modifier typing on the canvas). Grid Selection stays menu-bar only: the mock has one row. (2) A Figma or Photoshop user expects the layer menu and right click to carry the structure verb beside Group; right click puts Stack Selection directly under Group/Ungroup. (3) The mock prints the word at the row's right end in mono; the app prints row notes under the name because a chip beside the name starved it of width (2026-09-07), and this task asks for the second line. (4) A component original that is also a stack would carry two second lines; the layout word joins the component note on one line so the row does not grow. (5) Child words read along the way the stack runs: fill when set to Fill the Row/Stack, hug for text sized by its words and groups sized by their contents, fixed for everything with a drawn size. Grid children say nothing (a cell decides them). (6) Row order untouched, per the open card on column order.

Built: StackRowNote (PhotonzCore/StackRowNote.swift) on LayerRowDisplay.layoutNote, drawn under the name in LayersRow (mono 9.5, secondary, joins the component note on one line); Stack Selection first in LayersPanelHeader.MenuRow (⌃⌘G, Modifier.control added) and under Group/Ungroup in LayerCommandList (canStackRow/stackRow on rowMenuTargets); the menu bar row reads the same constant. Verified: StackRowNoteTests (13) + updated LayersPanelHeaderTests, full suite 12202 tests green; new walks layers-rows-say-row-or-column-walk and layers-rows-stack-by-right-click-walk green at Next defaults with real captures; neighbours layers-menu-icon-rows, layers-header-make-component, mirror-across-center, undo-hands-back-the-pick green. Rough items: mock wording and word placement went to follow-up the-layers-list-says-stack-words-the-way-the-aut with a decision card (blocked on it); accent on a picked row left grey for legibility (user rule 2026-09-30), stays in this log. Left rough, not filed: a piece stretched behind a stack or floated in front says nothing, and grid pieces say nothing, because neither is sized by a flow; the panel menu reader prints a leading divider before the first row (pre-existing, seen in older logs, not visible on screen).

Stack Selection is the first row of the Layers panel menu and in a layer row's right-click menu (⌃⌘G, the menu bar's name); stacked groups say row/column/grid and their pieces hug/fill/fixed on the row's second line; plain groups unchanged. Verified by StackRowNoteTests, full suite (12202 green), and walks layers-rows-say-row-or-column-walk + layers-rows-stack-by-right-click-walk at Next defaults.
